catalog.name: Hunter and Elmegreen 2006 UBV imaging of irregular galaxies

selection_rules.name_matching: remove ASCII spaces from the catalog Name field, then require one exact frozen target ID
selection_rules.photometric_geometry: among table2 rows whose filter string contains V, require one unique PA, b/a, center, and optical pixel scale
selection_rules.integrated_light: take the table3 row with the largest tabulated aperture radius
selection_rules.published_inclination: use table5 inclination only as a one-degree rounding audit, never as a fitted kinematic input

universal_geometry.reason: the source catalog declares q0=0.3 for irregular galaxies; no target-specific thickness is permitted

stellar_normalization.note: This is a declared universal nuisance bracket, not a gravity-law parameter. The nominal value is used to commission map construction before any sealed target kinematics are opened.
